phrases.text: This was the week Fortnite got a whole new island. Here's everything that changed, straight from Epic's own in-game news.
Every news tile, every update, from October 31st to November 7th.
Let's get into it!
First, the big one. On November 2nd, the game updated from version 42.40 to version 43.00.
And the map changed with it. Last week the official map had 40 places. Now it has 17.
And not one of the old places made it to the new island.
The week started on Halloween, with the last day of this tile in the news.
A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches.
That was the final day it showed up. The next day, the news was all new.
On November 1st, a new captain showed up.
A new Captain has taken over part of the Island!
Face the A$AP Rocky Boss to earn Lil' Flacko,
and blast away the competition with the A$AP Rocky's Shock Rocket.
And the A$AP Rocky Bundle is in today's Item Shop, listed at 3,200 V-Bucks.
The same day, One Piece arrived.
When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer!
Set sail with Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits and chart a course to uncharted waters.
All three are in today's shop on their own: Luffy at 1,800 V-Bucks, Nami and Usopp at 1,600 each.
And there's an emote tile with just three words on it.
GUM-GUM GATLING!
Still in the news today, a whole week later.
Quick one: if you're grabbing anything from the Item Shop this week, use code BAD. It really helps the channel.
On November 4th, Epic described the new island.
Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay,
or storm The $.$. Rocky on this mysterious skull-shaped island.
phrases.say: or storm the S S Rocky on this mysterious skull-shaped island.

phrases.text: Here's Arlong Park, on the west side of the island.
Baratie sits right next to Busy Bay, in the south-east.
And The $.$. Rocky is out on the east side.
phrases.say: And the S S Rocky is out on the east side.

phrases.text: Those are three of the spots. In all, the new island has 12 named locations. Here they are, clockwise from the north.
Loot Lagoon, in the north of the island.
Fortune's Fort, in the north-east of the island.
Cursed Cavern, near the center of the island.
Busy Bay, in the south-east of the island.
Plunder Port, in the south of the island.
Loguetown, in the south of the island.
Windmill Village, in the south-west of the island.
Lantern Landing, near the center of the island.
The Chest, in the north-west of the island.
Rubber Resort, in the north-west of the island.
Plus 5 landmarks, like Baratie, Henry and Boogie Boat.
Also on November 4th, a new tile went up.
Rare Devil Fruits have dropped in across the map!
Eat the Gum-Gum Fruit to stretch your skills as Luffy,
or the Flame-Flame Fruit to come in hot as Ace...
just stay away from water.
From November 2nd to the 4th, this one pointed players to a new tab.
All great adventures begin with a treasure map!
Head to the Treasure Tab to follow along with weekly progress and chart your next move.
Epic also ran a couple of tips in the news on November 1st and 2nd. This one is for squads.
All hope is not lost when a teammate goes down!
When they fall, they leave behind a Reboot Card.
Pick it up, take it to a Reboot Van, and bring them back into the fight for a better shot at victory.
And this one is the color guide for every weapon.
Weapons come in five rarities: Gray (Common), Green (Uncommon), Blue (Rare), Purple (Epic), and Orange (Legendary).
Higher rarity means better stats, so open Chests and swap out weapons when finding something better!
Back on October 31st, the tips were for new players. This one explains the two modes.
Standard Battle Royale lets players collect resources and build walls, ramps, and structures on the fly.
Zero Build removes building, so players can focus on combat and movement.
And this one is about where to land.
At the start of each match, drop from the Battle Bus and aim for a less crowded area.
This gives time to loot and gear up before the fight begins...
And one more, about staying alive.
Keeping track of Shields and Health is critical to survival.
Grab and consume Shield Potions as soon as possible, as low Shields means going down faster in a fight.
Those tips, the Treasure Tab and the Halloween tile have all left the news since. 9 tiles came and went this week.
And the newest tile is about today, November 7th.
Set sail for sparkling Sprites from 2-4 PM ET and 9-11 PM ET!
phrases.say: Set sail for sparkling Sprites from 2 to 4 PM Eastern and 9 to 11 PM Eastern!

phrases.text: Drop in with A$AP Rocky's Shock Rocket and a Self Revive,
and find more Fortune Sprite variants across the Island.
This video goes up at 4 PM Eastern, so the evening window, 9 to 11 PM Eastern, is still ahead.
Quick recap. A new version, 43.00, and a new island with 17 places.
A$AP Rocky as a boss, the Straw Hats in the shop, Devil Fruits on the map,
and Fortune Sprites tonight.
Which change is your favorite? Tell me in the comments!
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
